failure.rootCause: Test-harness regression in this branch, not the runtime. processes.test.ts `manager()` (lines 295-297) constructs `new TmuxRuntime({ tmux: { run: deps.run, socket: "legion-omp" }, project: "omp", ... })` with the socket/session and project hardcoded. Before the branch, ProcessManager derived them from state (`this.tmux = { run: deps.run, socket: \`legion-${deps.state.project}\` }`). The two live-tmux tests (processes.test.ts:5472 and :5522) create `project = smoke<Date.now()>` and drive `tmux -L legion-<project>` themselves for kill-pane/kill-session/list-windows, so the runtime spawns into tmux server `legion-omp` while the test kills panes on a server that does not exist: (a) `probe` stays alive -> the failing assertion; (b) the sibling test 'creates the first live root without a default bash window' now passes vacuously (its list-windows hits the non-existent server, so `.not.toContain("bash")` is trivially true); (c) every run leaks a real `legion-omp` tmux server whose windows run `sleep 999` (observed after one full-suite run + 3 repro runs: `tmux -L legion-omp list-windows -a` showed 5 windows named legion-42, panes %1-%5, @legion_owner=legion-omp; cleaned up with `tmux -L legion-omp kill-server`). The fix belongs in the test helper (derive socket `legion-${state.project}` and `project: state.project`), i.e. inside the enumerated `manager()/workerCapFixture build a TmuxRuntime` edit; no production code change is indicated by this failure.

preexistingFindings: Box-wide: `gh auth git-credential get` (the credential.https://github.com.helper in ~/.gitconfig, via ~/.dotfiles/shims/gh -> knives gh -> gh; also with KNIVES_GH_BYPASS=1 and with GH_CONFIG_DIR unset) hangs 60-90 s and prints nothing (10:20-10:30Z). git consults that helper before GIT_ASKPASS, so the daemon's `jj git clone https://github.com/sjawhar/legion-smoke` in provisionIssueWorkspace is killed by defaultRunner's 30 s timeout (state/fetch.ts:55) — clone dir created 10:15:30.9, state saved with launchFailures+1 at 10:16:00.9; second attempt 10:19:29.9 -> 10:19:59.8. A plain `git clone` with the `legion credential` helper takes 1.2 s (repo is 212K), so it is the credential lookup, not the network. Worked around for the rig only by starting its daemon with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/tmp/legion21-test/rig2/gitconfig (a copy of ~/.gitconfig with the two credential.helper lines removed) — the already-running private tmux server kept its own env, so panes were unaffected. Not a branch defect (packages/workspace and state/fetch.ts untouched by the PR).

packages/workspace ensureRepoClone (pre-existing): a clone killed mid-fetch leaves <repo>/.jj containing only .gitignore; the guard `existsSync(jjDir)` then treats the dir as a complete clone on the next attempt and the retry fails at `jj git fetch -R` instead of re-cloning. I removed the half-clone by hand before the retry.

Root launch-failure requeue (pre-existing): after a spawn failure the tree is requeued with launchFailures+1 but nothing periodic re-promotes a queued tree while admission has free slots (only admit/todo, releaseSlot, or boot reconcileAdmission do) — I re-admitted LEGSMOKE-35 by PATCHing it backlog -> todo, and the gate-off daemon restart promoted it at boot.

Boot-time OMP probe under load (pre-existing, noted in round 1): the daemon refused startup once at 10:41-10:44 (`[legion] Configured OMP invocation does not expose pi.agents`) while the load average spiked to 468; the retry supervisor (/tmp/legion21-test/r2-daemon-retry.sh) succeeded on the next attempt at load 342.
